tei:div.tei:p: bla ma rgyang 'bod mos gus dad pa'i gsos sbyin yod/ bla ma mkhyen/ bla ma mkhyen/ bla ma mkhyen/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo// lung rtogs dam chos kyi 'byung gnas// 'phags tshogs dge 'dun gyi mnga' bdag /rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no// byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid// dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi 'byung gnas// phrin las ci 'dod kun stsol mdzad// rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed mkhyen no// bla ma 'od dpag med mkhyen no// spros bral chos sku'i zhing nas gzigs shig /nang gsal 'pho chen gzhon nu bum skur// da lta nyid du grol bar mdzod cig /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang mkhyen no// lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing nas gzigs shig /rang byung sems nyid 'od gsal snying po// da lta nyid du rtogs par mdzod cig /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no// rnga yab padma 'od nas gzigs shig /rang gsal ye shes sgron me'i snang ba// da lta nyid du mthong bar mdzod cig /mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal mkhyen no// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing nas gzigs shig /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'-i tshogs gral// da lta nyid du phyin par mdzod cig /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams mkhyen no// ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings 110)nas gzigs shig /'khor 'das gzhi grol sems nyid chos skur// da lta nyid du rtogs par mdzod cig /rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje mkhyen no// me tog bkod pa'i zhing nas gzigs shig /mi 'gyur lhun grub bde chen 'og min// da lta nyid du bgrod par mdzod cig /chos rgyal ratna gling pa mkhyen no// chos 'khor bde chen gling nas gzigs shig /rim gnyis lam gyi mchog thun dngos grub// da lta nyid du grub par mdzod cig /rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa mkhyen no// lhun grub snang bzhi'i dbyings nas gzigs shig /gsang sngags tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam mchog /da lta nyid du phyin par mdzod cig

/mkhas grub karma chags med mkhyen no// rnam dag bde chen zhing nas gzigs shig /gdos bcas phung po ye shes 'od lus// da lta nyid du grol bar mdzod cig /rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab mkhyen no// sgom med 'od gsal dbyings nas gzigs shig /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho// da lta nyid du grol bar mdzod cig /padma lhun grub rgya mtsho mkhyen no// du ma ro gcig klong nas gzigs shig /chos tshul gsung rab nor bu'i gling du// da lta nyid du bgrod par mdzod cig /grub dbang padma nor bu mkhyen no// gzung 'dzin spros bral ngang nas gzigs shig /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub yid bzhin// da lta nyid du grub par mdzod cig /karma chos dpal bzang 111)po mkhyen no// rnal 'byor rtse gcig dbyings nas gzigs shig /mngon sum 'od gsal snang ba rnam bzhi// da lta nyid du 'byongs bar mdzod cig /'dren mchog karma lha dbang mkhyen no// chos nyid mngon sum klong nas gzigs shig /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad ma lus// da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod cig /'gyur med nges don bstan 'dzin mkhyen no// nyams snang gong 'phel ngang nas gzigs shig /nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal chen po// da lta nyid du 'byongs bar mdzod cig /padma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin mkhyen no// rig pa tshad phebs klong nas gzigs shig /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par// da lta nyid du rtogs par mdzod cig /klong chen nam mkha'i rdo rje mkhyen no// chos zad chos sku'i dbyings nas gzigs shig /'khrul snang zad par gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings// da lta nyid du 'jug par mdzod cig /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po mkhyen no// bka' babs bdun ldan dbyings nas gzigs shig /'gro kun phyam gcig byang chub snying por// da lta nyid du bgrod par mdzod cig /gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas mkhyen no// mdzod chen rnam lnga'i dbyings nas gzigs shig

/ye shes nyi mas ma rig mun pa/ 112) /da lta nyid du sangs bar mdzod cig /'jigs med chos kyi dbang po mkhyen no// tshad med thugs rje'i dbyings nas gzigs shig /rkyen snang gang byung byang chub lam du// da lta nyid du 'gro bar mdzod cig /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje mkhyen no// mkhyen gnyis ye shes klong nas gzigs shig /gzhan don rdzogs pa'i phrin las rlabs chen/ da lta nyid du grub par mdzod cig /'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje mkhyen no// gzung 'dzin 'khrul grol ngang nas gzigs shig /'khor ba'i 'khrul pa tshe 'di'i zhen pa// da lta nyid du zad par mdzod cig /rtogs ldan shākya shrī mkhyen no// don gnyis lhun grub dbyings nas gzigs shig /rtogs pa'i 'od 'bar thugs rje'i sprin phung*// da lta nyid du 'bar bar mdzod cig /'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros mkhyen no// 'od gsal sgyu ma'i klong nas gzigs shig /snang srid snod bcud rmi lam sgyu mar// da lta nyid du 'byongs bar mdzod cig kye/ ma dal 'byor thob dus dam chos ma sgrub na// phyis nas lus rten rnyed par mi 'gyur bas// tshe 'di'i bya bas skad cig mi g.yeng bar// dal 'byor snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs// skad cig mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos can de// rnam par brtags 113)na snying po 'ga' med pas// lbu ba brdos 'dra yid rton mi rung bas// mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// las 'bras bslu ba med par ma shes par// 'khor bar thar dus med pa'i las ngan bsags// gzod dka' srid pa'i g.yang sa chen po las// skyo shas gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gtan bde thar pa'i lam mchog yang dag pa// rnam dkar dge ba'i dpung tshogs mang bsags nas// zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i skal pa longs spyod pa'i// nges 'byung bcos min skye bar byin= skyabs kyi mthar thug ston pa bla na med// blang dor lam ston rnam thar tshul bzhin skyongs// dge la sbyor ba'i gral du dbugs 'byin pa'i// sems mchog rgyud la skye bar byin=

mchog thun grub gnyis gser gyi gegs gyur pa// nyes pa'i dri ma sgo drug dang ldan pa// stobs rnams bzhi yis bdud rtsi'i gru char gyis// lhag ma med par dag par byin= sku gnyis dpal ni tshogs zung gis bskrun pas// bya sla chod che 114) maṇḍal phul ba yis// grangs med bskal pa'i dge spyad dbang bsdus nas// tshogs chen myur du rdzogs par byin= sangs rgyas dngos snang bla ma he ru kar// mnyes pa'i bya ba rtag tu brtson byas zhing*// mos gus gdung ba'i shugs kyis rab bskul bas// thugs rgyud dgongs pa 'pho bar byin= gnas lugs rig pa bde gshegs snying po'i khams// glo bur gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i sprin bral ba'i// rang ngo 'gyur med ye ji bzhin pa yi// rang zhal mngon sum mthong bar byin= sna chogs g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi// g.yeng ba'i tshogs bcom rang gnas mi 'gyur ba'i// gshis la dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin nas kyang*// nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// gzung 'dzin sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho rol kun// chos nyid dbyings su thams cad ro gcig pa// nang gsal rig gdangs lhag par 'bar ba yi// rig pa tshad la pheb par byin gyis rlobs// mthar thug yul sems nyams kyi rol rtsal kun// nang gsal klong du thams cad 'ub chub par// thim la ma rmugs phra ba'i ye shes gdangs/ gzhon nu bum skur gtan srid zin par shog ces pa'ang smar shod go 'jo ba blo gsal blo gros mtha' yas bzhed ngor dpal chen 'dus pas so// 115)༄༅/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ khyad par o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang*// mkhan chen zhi mtsho chos rgyal khri srong gi /bden pa chen pos kha char chod gyur cig /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*// rgya gar grub thob chen po brgyad cu lnga// rje 'bangs nyer lnga yer pa'i grub chen brgya'i// bden pa chen pos=

so zur gnubs nyang gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad// kun mkhyen klong chen rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling*// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin mkhas grub rgya mtsho yi// bden pa chen pos= sa skya'i gong ma lnga dang mar mi dwags// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa sogs// phyi 'gyur mkhas grub bye ba sa ya yi// bden pa chen pos= sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor tshogs chen 'dus pa dang*// sgyu 'phrul zhi khro he ru ka galpo// zla gsang rta mchog rdo rje phur pa yi// bden pa chen pos= che mchog yang dag gshin rje padma dbang*// ma mo phur pa dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga yi// bden pa chen pos= 116) gsang 'dus kye rdor ma ya 'khor lo sdom// gdan bzhi thod pa 'jigs byed dus 'khor sogs// gsang sngags phyi nang rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi// bden pa chen pos= rdo rje phag mo gsang ba ye shes dang*// rje btsun sgrol ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal sogs// gnas yul dpa' bo ḍākki bye ba brgya'i// bden pa chen= sngags kyi srung ma legs ldan ma ning nag /gza' bdud rdor legs dur khrod lha mo dang*// tshe ring mched lnga yang le ber sogs kyi// bden pa chen= phyag bzhi phyag drug zhal bzhi rdo rje gur// dud sol lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// gsar rnying srung ma rab 'byams rgya mtsho yi// bden pa chen pos= dkon mchog bden pa nam yang bslu ba med// don dam bden pa stong nyid spros pa med// kun rdzob bden pa rgyu 'bras bslu ba med// bslu med bden pas kha char chod gyur cig zhes pa'ang ma hā su kha'i zhal 'don khag sab du padma ma ṇis so// kha bsgyur na/ bden pa chen pos thub bstan rgyas gyur cig bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan shog dge 'dun rgyas gyur cig 'jin rten bde gyur cig 117) nad yams zhi bar shog dus 'khrugs zhi gyur cig char chen 'bebs gyur cig

lo phyugs legs par shog mgron lam bde bar shog 'dod don 'grub gyur cig sdug bsngal zhi bar shog bde skyid ldan gyur cig sangs rgyas 'grub gyur cig tshe 'di blo thong shog skyo shas skye bar shog nges 'byung 'khrungs bar shog rang 'dod zhi bar shog gzhan phan skye bar shog chags sdang zhi bar shog byang sems skye bar shog sbyin pa gtong gyur cig tshul khrims dag par shog bzod pa sgoms par shog brtson 'grus brtson par shog bsam gtan sgom par shog shes rab skye bar shog lta ba rtogs par shog sgom pa goms par shog spyod pa bogs dbyung shog 'bras bu mthar phyin shog dam chos 'dzin par shog dal 'byor thob par shog mi rtag dran gyur cig nyes dmigs shes gyur cig rgyu 'bras yid ches shog thar lam snyeg gyur cig bla mas thugs zin shog dkon mchog blo khel shog 118) sems can don byed shog sdig sgrib zhi bar shog tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog bla ma mnyes par shog gnas lugs rtogs par shog sa lam bgrod par shog gtum mo 'byongs bar shog sgyu lus ldang bar shog 'od gsal rtogs par shog rmi lam zin par shog 'pho ba 'byongs bar shog bar do ngos zin shog zhes sogs gang 'dod 'dod du bsgyur ro/ zhes pa'ang badzra dzñā na'i bzhed ngor pad nor pas so/ dge'o//
